decisions.reason: Management has already invested in and publicly committed to this coolant cleaning centrifuge, and its fit with the established coolant management line makes dropping it difficult despite any disappointing results.
As a multi-model product line, the coolant nozzles represent a highly visible and substantial investment, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping the line.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor builds on the firm's core conveying expertise and has accumulated investment and public commitment, so management will likely persist with it.
